content: Bottom sheet menus in React Native: @gorhom/bottom-sheet is the industry standard (uses Reanimated 2/3 + Gesture Handler). Key patterns: snap points (25%/50%/90%), backdrop overlay for modal dismissal, handle indicator (36pt wide, 5pt tall), large top corner radius (16-20pt). iOS-style: peek/half/full states, rubber banding, parallax. Best practices: use snap points not fixed heights, leverage Reanimated for 60fps, enable panDownToClose, handle keyboard avoiding view. For creation flows: icon + text + chevron rows, primary action first (Record Voice), two options max to avoid overwhelm.
